cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the SEO Specialist position at your company. With a strong background in on-page SEO, technical audits, and content optimization, I am eager to help your clients achieve higher rankings and increased organic traffic.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, which has directly improved their organic visibility. I write keyword-targeted blog content that drives traffic, and I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and the Astra theme. My daily use of SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console ensures data-driven decisions that align with SEO best practices.

One of my proudest achievements is my own project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Through iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, I measurably raised the site's search-health score, demonstrating my ability to identify and resolve issues.

I am detail-oriented, analytical, and committed to staying updated on the latest SEO trends and algorithm changes. My technical foundation in web development, combined with my content and SEO skills, allows me to collaborate effectively with design and development teams.

I am confident that my experience and passion for SEO make me a strong fit for this role. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team's success.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
